channel.title: Agri & fertilisers · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Agri & fertilisers in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+1.1).

item.title: [+1] India's LNG imports from Qatar surge nearly 370% in October as supplies recover
item.description:
Adds to expected record October LNG imports of 2.8 million tonnes. Recovery from earlier disruption, though at high prices and now threatened by Iran's renewed closure.

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Fertiliser feedstock

Why it matters: More gas supports power, fertiliser and city gas, but high prices raise the import bill and any new Hormuz closure risks the flow.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Commerce minister says the US trade deal protects sensitive interests and gives India a strong advantage
item.description:
He said details are not yet public and people will celebrate the terms. Follows weeks of talks reported as close but stuck. Progressing.

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Farm exports

Why it matters: A deal with lower US tariffs would help exporters of textiles, engineering goods and farm products and improve the trade outlook.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
